notes: VCA302: Cash Book can now be closed on a non-trading day. The 'enter Buyer Betel Collections before closing the tally' gate applied to EVERY day with zero collections — so a day opened only by a back-dated bonus payout (no auction, no collections) could never be closed. The gate now applies only on a real trading day (cash sales / seller invoice payments / gate-kooli-vadagai / commission / invoices present); a day whose only activity is a non-trading cash movement (bonus payout, loan repayment, manual expense) closes without it. A genuine auction day still requires collections.
